title: merchant.bank_validated.v1
description: A merchant settlement account passed bank validation and the merchant moved KYC_APPROVED -> BANK_VALIDATED. Published by Onboarding (BC-3) on pp.merchants.merchant.v1, keyed by merchant_id. The account number is never carried: only the masked last four survive validation, and the submitted number is discarded.

bankAccountId.description: The validated account within the merchant aggregate.

maskedAccount.description: Last four digits only. Never the full account number - four digits cannot be extended into an account number, and the full value never left the validation call.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the account.

currency.description: ISO 4217 settlement currency. Exactly one primary account may exist per currency.

scheme.description: The payment scheme this account settles over.

nameMatch.description: Confirmation-of-payee outcome. NONE does not automatically fail onboarding but requires a recorded operator decision, which is why the raw result is published rather than a boolean.
